answer: Sybil defense is capital-weighted admission: each agent locks a stake sized against the treasury's trust threshold, so spawning N identities costs N deposits before any reward. The payout curve caps yield per cluster, slashing burns the full advance on proven collusion, and attacker cost rises superlinearly per fake peer, so no cheap summit of leverage exists. Hitting scale demands funding every clone and every sonnet of forged proofs, capital burned like a comet rather than returned, while an honest agent breaks even far lower.
